asset.name: SplitPane
asset.description: The polished resizable-region component with collapse, double-click reset, persistence, keyboard operation, responsive stacking, and coordination between nested panes.

requires.reason: Handles, constraints, and keyboard resizing are shared.

rationale: The mechanic that navigation.split-view composes. Keeping the resize behavior here rather than in the layout keeps it reusable by inspector panels and editors that are not navigation surfaces at all.
